goal: Coordinate worker bots to audit the /portal experience, record compliance status with the AGENTS requirements, and keep a delegated task memory for next steps.
constraints: All application routes and portal pages must remain under /portal/* to respect the route boundary requirement.
Portal UI changes must enforce error boundaries, toast notifications, menu grouping, and WCAG AA contrast as noted in AGENTS.md.
Every failure path must surface explicit feedback (no silent failures).
Work should document reproduction, root cause, code change, validation, and commit message when fixing issues.
No silent dependency on missing scripts; adapt even when referenced helpers (like scripts/task_memory.py) don’t exist.

tasks.title: Inventory /portal routes and their hosting components
deliverables: Catalog of /portal routes from App.jsx plus relevant files (layouts, rbac nav entries).
List of vendor wrappers (FeatureRoute, PortalLayout) that enforce permissions so future edits stay within /portal namespace.
tasks.notes: App.jsx lazily loads dashboard and module pages; lib/rbac.js builds the nav groups. Use those files to ensure portals stay under /portal/*. Artifact stored at .codex/portal-route-inventory.md.

tasks.title: Audit AGENTS requirements coverage inside portal UX
deliverables: Checklist showing which pages/components already use ErrorBoundary wrappers and toast notifications.
Menu structure validation ensuring new menu items are grouped logically and roles are honored.
Contrast verification report referencing theme tokens (colors in theme/tokens if available) against WCAG AA ratios.
tasks.notes: Focus on PortalLayout, Navigation, and any component that calls toast, to verify every failure path reports explicitly per rule.

tasks.title: Draft implementation tasks for detected gaps
deliverables: Concrete steps with targeted files for adding missing error boundaries/toasts/menu grouping fixes.
Validation plan covering reproduction steps, root cause description, code change summary, validation actions, and commit messaging as mandated.
tasks.notes: Plan should bundle fixes into work that naturally fits inside the AGENTS fix delivery format so nothing is incomplete.

updates.summary: Initialized delegated task memory in response to the user's coordination request.
Captured the portal route inventory artifact for T1 completion.

artifacts.description: Portal route and navigation inventory for worker-scout output.
